title: Free cocompletion by space-valued presheaves
statement:
Use the infinity categories and nested universes $\mathcal U\in\mathcal U\prime$ of [def-coef-complete-algebroid], and the coherent functor and mapping-space conventions of [def-cbc-enhanced-diagrams-cones]. Small means $\mathcal U$-small, and $\mathcal S$ denotes the infinity category of small spaces. Let $D$ be a small infinity category. The infinity category $\mathcal P(D)=\operatorname{Fun}(D^{\mathrm{op}},\mathcal S)$ has small mapping spaces and admits all small colimits. Write $j:D\to\mathcal P(D)$ for $d\mapsto\operatorname{Map}_D(-,d)$. For every infinity category $\mathcal V$ in the larger universe admitting all small colimits, restriction along $j$ induces an equivalence of infinity categories
$$j^*:\operatorname{Fun}_{\mathrm{colim}}(\mathcal P(D),\mathcal V)\simeq\operatorname{Fun}(D,\mathcal V),$$
where the left side is the full subcategory of coherent functors preserving small colimits. The equivalence includes natural transformations and their higher simplices, so an equivalence between the restrictions of two such functors lifts to a natural equivalence between those functors.
